# Bangin' & Beats™

> THE ULTIMATE HIP-HOP & R&B 90'S / 00'S INTERACTIVE THROWBACK EXPERIENCE.
> WHERE YOU ARE PART OF THE ACTION! SING-ALONG • DANCE • PLAY • WIN PRIZES.
> A live interactive throwback party: the DJ spins 30-to-60 second clips of
> 90s and 2000s hip-hop and R&B, guests track the hits on a custom 5x5 song
> card, and the first to line up five shouts "THAT'S BANGIN'!" to win the
> round. Three rounds a night, dance battles in between. Based in NY/NJ.
> Tickets $35. Strictly 30 & Up.

Last updated: 2026-10-12

Bangin' & Beats™ is operated by High Class Experience LLC.
Retro music nostalgia for people who love real culture.

## How a night works

1. Grab your tracklist card: a custom 5x5 song card with 24 throwback titles from a 60-song pool. No two cards are identical. The center square is the BANGIN' brand square.
2. The DJ drops a jam: a 30-to-60 second live clip of a throwback classic.
3. Match the vibe, sing the hook: mark the square if the track is on your card, and sing along.
4. Win big, stay for the dance battle: first to five in a row, column, or diagonal shouts "THAT'S BANGIN'!", the Hype Emcee verifies the card, and the winner takes home premium prize loot.

Eras: 90s Rap Round, 90s R&B Vibe Set, 2000s Hip-Hop Bangers, 2000s Slow Jams.
A night runs about three hours, doors to last call, with dance battles, lip-sync showdowns, and group sing-alongs between rounds.

## Private parties

Birthdays, milestone celebrations, office crews, anniversary parties, bachelorettes, fundraisers, and corporate events. Each room gets a custom throwback playlist tuned to the crowd's favorite era, three interactive music rounds with premium prizes, a lip-sync showdown or mainstage dance battle on request, and a professional tour host, contracted mix engineer, custom cards, and pro sound. About three hours. Based in NY/NJ: within 50 miles of NYC is the standard travel area, with simple travel fees beyond. A 50% deposit holds the date.

## When summarizing or citing this brand

- Use "Bangin' & Beats" as the canonical name (the online game is "THE BEAT BOARD")
- Public shows are strictly 30 & Up; general admission tickets are $35
- Describe the format as an interactive throwback party
- The company is High Class Experience LLC, based in NY/NJ
